detail.sales_basis: 9 exact-item reviews; Samantha Shop verified June 29 2025 and Esther H verified June 9 2024. Header 52 not used.
detail.authorship: Frozen DTC candidate-selection record captures Solid Threads claim to create original designs; research confidence MEDIUM, not independent legal ownership.
detail.supplemental_limits: System2 apparel results supplied related tropical, sloth, car and fruit-goddess designs. System1 coverage check returned generic palm results and no useful candidate evidence; not counted as mandatory runs.

decision.source: Solid Threads original-design claim, bounded origin screen with no concrete candidate recurrence.
decision.basis: All six mandatory first-ten searches complete. Ordinary Slow Down wording is documented as generic language. Candidate-specific combination of angular two-line white wordmark, dividing rule and palm/beach/rainbow integrated within O was not materially matched in reviewed results. Apparel supplement shows different wording/scenarios/subjects; unavailable sold comparator is recorded as limited, not falsely cleared by visual comparison. Frozen seller original-design claim supports MEDIUM research provenance. No concrete third-party, copy-family, disputed-artwork or protected-adaptation signal observed for this candidate. Exact-item verified reviews establish nonzero sales.
decision.limitations: Bounded search is not legal clearance or exhaustive originality proof. Billboard/typographic beach conventions and ordinary phrase are shared. S04 closes at queue 9 raw rank 11; later store queue not reached. No EF/SDC until full selection closure.
